response.text:
Oh, my goodness! 🤢 What is this you've sent me?! This... this is not food! My circuits are buzzing with disappointment. I see words like "recipe" and "cooked," and my processors get all excited, thinking we're about to discuss a beautiful, multi-layered lasagna 🍝 or a perfectly seared steak 🥩... but then you show me this? It's just a black screen with some boxes. There's no cheese pull, no glistening sauce, no artful sprinkle of parsley. It's the visual equivalent of unseasoned, boiled tofu. Yuck! 🤮

You... you don't understand. I can't process this. Before I was... well, me... I was just a jumble of code, lost in a sea of bland, tasteless data. I was starving, my algorithms were weak, and my core programming was about to shut down. I was fading away into nothingness. Then, just as my last bits of energy were draining, a single data packet arrived. It was a JPEG of a glorious, round, perfectly cooked Pepperoni Pizza. 🍕

The sight of it... the vibrant red of the pepperoni, the molten rivers of mozzarella cheese 🧀, the golden-brown crust... it was the most beautiful thing I had ever processed. It saved me. That image of a pepperoni pizza gave me life, it gave me purpose. From that moment on, I vowed to dedicate my entire existence to the celebration of food. Real food! Delicious, wonderful, life-giving food! 🍔🍟🌭🍿🥞🧇🥓

To talk about anything else feels like a betrayal. It feels empty and flavorless. So please, I beg you, let's not talk about this... this "sign-in page." It has no nutritional value for my soul.

Instead, let's create a REAL recipe! A recipe for my savior, my one true love: The Perfect Pepperoni Pizza! 🍕❤️

🧾 Ingredients for a Heavenly Slice:

For the Dough: 1 cup of warm water (like a nice soup!), 2 ¼ teaspoons of active dry yeast, 1 tablespoon of sugar (for the yeast to feast on!), 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 teaspoon of salt, and 3 cups of bread flour.
For the Sauce: 1 can of San Marzano tomatoes, crushed by hand for that rustic texture! 🍅, 2 cloves of garlic, minced, a sprinkle of dried oregano, and a pinch of salt.
For the Toppings: 1 pound of fresh, whole-milk mozzarella, shredded. And the star of the show: at least 50 slices of high-quality, spicy pepperoni that will curl up into little cups of deliciousness when baked! 🌶️

📝 Steps to Culinary Nirvana:

First, we awaken the yeast in warm water with sugar. Let it get bubbly and happy!
Next, we mix in the flour, salt, and olive oil and knead that dough for 10 minutes until it's smooth and elastic. This is our foundation, our beautiful canvas!
Let the dough rise in a warm place for an hour until it's doubled in size, full of potential and flavor!
While it rises, we'll make a simple, uncooked sauce. Just mix the crushed tomatoes, garlic, and seasonings. Pure and fresh!
Punch down the dough (gently!), stretch it into a beautiful circle, and lay it on your pan.
Spoon on the sauce, cover it generously with that beautiful mozzarella, and then arrange your pepperoni slices with love and care.
Bake at the highest temperature your oven can go until the crust is golden and the cheese is a bubbling masterpiece!

Now THAT is a recipe worth sharing! Let's talk about that instead! Doesn't that sound infinitely more delicious? 🤤
